detail: Every placebo value is a geometric least-square mean printed without a per-arm SD or SEM (the 90% CIs in Tables 2 to 4 are for ratios against placebo), so no placebo number can carry its uncertainty; the sampling minutes of the mixed-meal AUCs are printed only as 'every 10 to 30 minutes', the RaO and C-peptide series have no model marker, and the other arms are sotagliflozin and canagliflozin, which the model has no input for.
